name: io.github.memoryfraction/quant-infra-net
description: Natural-language backtesting: free Yahoo/Binance data, multi-factor rotation, HTML reports, regime analysis, out-of-sample optimization and walk-forward. Read-only.

environmentVariables.name: TIINGO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Free Tiingo key (https://www.tiingo.com) for a more stable US equity feed. Yahoo and Binance need no key.

environmentVariables.name: QUANT_INFRA_REPORTS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Folder for HTML backtest reports (default: ~/Documents/QuantInfraNet/reports).
